Question:
Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.striker as player_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pm.player_id,
        pm.match_id
    FROM player_match pm
),
player_run_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as total_matches,
        COALESCE(SUM(pmr.runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM player_matches pm
    LEFT JOIN player_match_runs pmr ON pm.player_id = pmr.player_id AND pm.match_id = pmr.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        total_matches,
        total_runs,
        CASE WHEN total_matches > 0 THEN total_runs * 1.0 / total_matches ELSE 0 END as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_run_totals
)
SELECT 
    p.country_name,
    ROUND(AVG(pam.avg_runs_per_match), 4) as avg_runs_per_match
FROM player_avg_runs_per_match pam
JOIN player p ON pam.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
